niche_preference_profile: This user tends to prefer interfaces with rounded, pill-shaped components; clear, prominent primary actions; cleaner and simpler control sets; strong but controlled visual hierarchy; and layouts that feel polished and visually complete. Their color preference is mixed by context, but they repeatedly favor cool-toned accents, vivid imagery, and interfaces that avoid feeling flat, empty, or weakly emphasized.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers larger rounded cards, softer corners, and fully pill-shaped buttons over sharper or more rectangular components.
Prefers large, obvious, strongly emphasized actions, including full-width or pill-shaped buttons and secondary actions that are still clearly rendered as buttons rather than plain text.
Prefers fewer, cleaner controls and shorter, more direct copy over busier icon sets or more explanatory wording.
Prefers title-first, clearly structured layouts with important information integrated prominently rather than split across weaker sub-sections.
Prefers screens that feel complete and informative, such as including vivid media/artwork and fuller supporting content like upcoming fixtures.
Prefers cool blue or purple accents and glowing emphasis more often than hot pink, monochrome, or weaker accent treatments.
Prefers immersive overlay or floating card treatments with noticeable depth and shadow over flatter, separated, or less dimensional presentations.
